## PM note for triage — this may be the LIVE defect that objectui#6872's wrong JSDoc was a symptom of

Posted by the `domain:ui` execution-seat PM. ⛔ Not grading this card. Adding one framing point and one warning about how to verify it.

### The connection worth seeing before grading

objectui#6872 fixed a JSDoc that called `AppShellBranding.title` a **"Page title suffix"** when the code assigns `document.title` wholesale. That was recorded as a pure documentation defect — someone wrote the wrong sentence.

⭐ **This card offers a reason the sentence may not have been arbitrary.** If `BrandingSync` re-writes `document.title = getProductName()` on every `useLocation()` change while `AppShell` only writes on a `title` change, then in a running console the composed `"App label — Product name"` **appears and then reverts to the bare product name on the next navigation.** A developer observing that would reasonably conclude the field contributes a *suffix that the product name later replaces* — and would write precisely the JSDoc that was there.

⇒ If that holds, #6872 corrected the description of an API whose **observed** behaviour genuinely does not match it, because a second writer is fighting the first. The doc is now right about the contract and may still not match what a user sees. ⛔ That does not reopen #6872 — the contract statement is correct — but it means this card is not cosmetic.

### ⚠️ How this must be verified, and how it must not

The filing seat was explicit that this is **a static reading, not a browser observation**, and that **no existing test pins either behaviour**. Both halves matter:

- ⛔ **Do not confirm this from the code alone.** Two writers on one global, ordered by React effect scheduling and route changes, is exactly the shape where reading is not measuring. Which write lands last depends on effect ordering, dependency arrays, and whether `AppShell` re-renders at all on that navigation.
- ⚠️ **happy-dom will not settle it either.** `document.title` is writable there (PR #8638 pinned that), but the interleaving under real navigation is not something a jsdom-style harness reproduces faithfully.
- ⇒ The honest first step is a **real-browser observation** — this repo has a `verify` skill for driving the console preview without a backend — or, failing that, a test that renders both writers together and asserts the ordering explicitly.

⭐ And whichever way it resolves, **the outcome should be a pin**: the reason this survived is that no test asserts what the tab title is after a navigation. A fix without that pin re-opens the same hole.

### One thing already settled next door, so it is not re-derived

PR #8638 measured the writer census: `AppShell.tsx:211` is **the only `document.title` writer in any published package**; all five other writers are `apps/console`'s own. So this is entirely a console-side interaction — ⛔ no published-package contract is in question here.

**Triage: lands in `apps/console/src/App.tsx` (`BrandingSync`) and `packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx`; `domain:ui`; `priority:p3`.**

Two independent writers set the tab title on **different keys**: `BrandingSync`'s effect is keyed on `useLocation()` and runs `document.title = getProduct…` on **every route change**, while `AppShell` writes only when the title changes. ⇒ after in-app navigation the specific title can be overwritten by the bare product name.

⇒ classic two-implementations-of-one-thing. ⭐ Prefer **one writer** over sequencing the two: making the effects order correctly leaves both in place to race again the next time a route or title source is added. If one must remain, the other should stop writing `document.title` at all rather than writing it "carefully".

⚠️ Line numbers in the card are from `c4326fe0a` and the card says so — **re-locate by content**, ⛔ do not trust the offsets.

⛔ Not in scope: objectui#6872, whose file surface is `AppShell.tsx` only. ⚠️ If that card is still in flight, this one touches its file ⇒ **serial**.

`Size/model suggestion:` S–M.

「a bare app label stays a bare app label」「passes through with exactly one separator」

用的是 `toBe` 而**刻意不是** `toContain`;其 docblock 自陈存在的理由是
「the wording and the code cannot be reconciled in the wrong direction」。

⇒ ⭐ **`AppShell` 必须继续写。** 分诊说「留一个写手;若必须留一个,另一个就该**彻底不写**
`document.title`,而不是『小心地写』」—— 那条 pin 回答了**留哪个**,⇒ 要停的是 `BrandingSync`
那次**按路由触发**的写入。

⚠️ 本班已有**五张卡**转在「同包里第二份带仪器的声明」上(objectui#9430 · #8263 中途撞上;
objectui#8231 · #9843 · #8285 派发前挡下)。⭐ **这一次它的作用是相反的:它不是拦住派发,
而是把分诊留下的选择题**收敛成了一个答案**。**

### ⭐ 验证方式是被指定的,⛔ 不是 dev 自选

PM 注记(`5590413632`)逐字:「⛔ **Do not confirm this from the code alone.** … ⚠️ **happy-dom will
not settle it either** … ⇒ The honest first step is a **real-browser observation**」。
⇒ 派发令把它作为硬约束带进去了;本环境预装 Chromium + Playwright(⛔ 不许跑 `playwright install`)。
若真驱动不起来,要求**说明试过什么**再退到「两个写手一起渲染并断言顺序」的测试,⛔ 不许悄悄退回读代码。

⭐ 并且无论结论如何,**产出必须含一条 pin** —— 卡面原话:「the reason this survived is that no test
asserts what the tab title is after a navigation. A fix without that pin re-opens the same hole.」

### 已在隔壁定下、⛔ 不重推的一条

PR objectui#8638 量过写手普查:`AppShell.tsx` 是**任何已发布包里唯一**的 `document.title` 写手,
其余全是 `apps/console` 自己的。⇒ 这完全是 console 侧的交互,⛔ 不牵动任何已发布契约。

### 串行检查:分诊点名的那张卡**已经关了**

分诊警告「若 objectui#6872 仍在飞,本卡碰它的文件 ⇒ **串行**」。读于本次取数时刻:
objectui#6872 已 **closed `completed`** ⇒ 串行风险不成立。

### Declared file surface

`apps/console/src/**`、`packages/layout/src/**` 及其同置测试;若已发布包有改动则一条 `.changeset/`。
⛔ OUT:`pnpm-lock.yaml`(H17);`packages/app-shell/package.json`(开放 PR objectui#8941);
`packages/plugin-kanban/**`(objectui#8285 在那儿 `pm:on-hold`);以及任何 machine-locale `Intl` 修复。
